continuity_scope: Hollow Knight original English Windows base release by Team Cherry (24 February 2017). This pass uses Team Cherry's official game page only for base-game premise/mechanics; later free content packs, console/PS5/Switch 2 ports, patches, and endgame variants are excluded as narrative witnesses.
work_or_witnesses: Hollow Knight original Windows release (Team Cherry; 24 February 2017)
Team Cherry official Hollow Knight game page
Team Cherry 'Hollow Knight is Live!' release post
Nintendo UK publisher-provided Hollow Knight description
coverage_rule: Include only stable named/title-designated dramatic individuals directly characterized in accessible first-party material. The official page directly calls the player character 'the enigmatic Knight'; this pass contains that one record. Other named NPCs/bosses are omitted because the selected official pages provide no claim-level individual profiles for them.
omissions: Silksong is a separate Team Cherry game/sequel and is excluded.
Hidden Dreams, The Grimm Troupe, Lifeblood, and Godmaster are later free content packs, not base-release character or ending witnesses here.
Console ports, Voidheart Edition, the 2025/2026 refreshed or current-gen versions, patches, and localization changes are separate version witnesses.
Named NPCs, bosses, Dream No More/Godmaster/endgame variants, optional encounters, exact identity/origin claims, and fan theories are omitted for lack of selected official profile evidence.
uncertainties: The official character designation is 'the enigmatic Knight'; the source does not resolve identity, origin, speech, body/being taxonomy, kinship, or final fate.

The original PC launch date is confirmed by Team Cherry's later Silksong announcement; the original release post was dated February 26 while describing the game as live, so no more granular launch-time assertion is made.

Team Cherry's present game page retrospectively advertises four content packs. Its general base-premise claims are used, but pack-specific characters, quests, abilities, and endings are not imported into this pass.
The official description uses insects/bugs as a presentation category. It does not license real-world entomological classifications or fan-lore conclusions.
evidence_basis: Team Cherry official game/release pages and Nintendo's publisher-provided product description. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, lore theory, datamine, or route-specific playthrough serves as character evidence.

citations.locator: Descend into the Dark; lines 4-29 and 30-51
supports: Knight designation, Dirtmouth/forgotten kingdom premise, exploration, tainted creatures, skills, and later content-pack boundary
original PC release date and Silksong-as-sequel boundary
Team Cherry Windows launch post and postlaunch patch boundary
Hallownest, curse, insects/creatures, combat abilities, languages, and later Switch content boundary
